AGRICULTURAL PESTICIDES ORDINANCE
AGRICULTURAL PESTICIDES ORDINANCE (II OF 1971)
[25th January, 1971 ]
An Ordinance to
regulate the import, manufacture, formulation, sale, distribution and use of
pesticides
CHAPTER I
INTRODUCTORY
1. Short title, extent and
commencement: (1) This Ordinance may be called the
Agricultural Pesticides Ordinance, 1971.
(2) It extends to
the whole of Pakistan.
(3) It shall come
into force at once.
